item.veilreach.astral_sigil.tooltip: Use on a Moonwoven Frame to awaken a Hush Portal.
item.veilreach.astral_sigil.tooltip2: Your first path into Hushlands starts here.
item.veilreach.astral_sigil.fail_frame: The sigil only responds to a Moonwoven Frame.
item.veilreach.lunar_fiber.tooltip: A pale thread used in Hushlands crafting.
item.veilreach.mirror_ingot.tooltip: Forge Mirrorsteel gear from the spoils of Hushlands.
item.veilreach.little_bird.tooltip: Fast scout helicopter with forward rockets and bomber-style cluster drops.
item.veilreach.little_bird.tooltip2: Pilot: jump to climb, C to descend, A/D to yaw, W/S to adjust speed.
item.veilreach.little_bird.tooltip3: Press V to add a lock on the exact target under your crosshair, B to fire tracking missiles, X to clear locks, R for rocket salvos, and G for cluster bombs.
item.veilreach.rift_skimmer.tooltip: A low-slung hover scout built for fast lane changes and skimming the hush.
item.veilreach.rift_skimmer.tooltip2: Pilot: R fires pulse bolts. W/S adjust speed, A/D strafe, Space climbs, C descends.
item.veilreach.rift_siege_platform.toolt: Heavy floating siege frame built to break lines and hold the air.
Pilot: R fires the main cannon, G launches suppressor charges, Space climbs, C descends.
item.veilreach.starfragment.tooltip: A relic shard needed to assemble a Warden Sigil.
item.veilreach.sanctum_key.tooltip: Recovered from the Sunken Sanctum. One half of the final rite.
item.veilreach.cathedral_seal.tooltip: Recovered from Moonfall Cathedral. One half of the final rite.
item.veilreach.warden_sigil.tooltip: Present this at a Sealed Altar.
item.veilreach.warden_sigil.tooltip2: It will awaken the Hush Sovereign.
item.veilreach.hush_ward_charm.tooltip: Grants protection and sight within the silver hush.
item.veilreach.hush_ward_charm.use: The ward hushes the silver fog around you.
item.veilreach.sovereign_ward.tooltip: A stronger ward that turns the hush to your advantage.
item.veilreach.sovereign_ward.use: The Sovereign Ward hardens the hush around you.
message.veilreach.hushlands.hazard: The silver fog presses in. A Hush Ward Charm would steady your breath.
message.veilreach.hushlands.outer: The outer hush is thin, but it still chews at your breath.
message.veilreach.hushlands.mid: The rift belt is corrosive here. A Hush Ward Charm is needed to endure it.
message.veilreach.hushlands.inner: The inner hush is crushing you. Only a Sovereign Ward can steady the way forward.
message.veilreach.fogbound_barrier.locke: A heavy veil seals the way. A Hush Ward Charm should steady it.
A heavy veil seals the crossing. A Hush Ward Charm should steady it.
The inner seal recoils from you. A Warden Sigil or Sovereign Ward is needed here.
message.veilreach.fogbound_barrier.opene: The fogbound seal loosens and the passage opens.
message.veilreach.portal.invalid_frame: The sigil needs a complete Moonwoven Frame.
message.veilreach.portal.opened: The air parts. A gate to the Hushlands opens.
message.veilreach.sealed_altar.locked: A silent ward rejects you. The altar needs a Warden Sigil.
message.veilreach.sealed_altar.missing_r: The altar remains silent. It still hungers for the Sanctum Key and the Cathedral Seal.
message.veilreach.sealed_altar.awakened: The seal breaks, and the Sovereign answers.
message.veilreach.starlight_cache.opened: A stash of starlit metal spills from the cache.
message.veilreach.vehicle.repair_pad.use: The repair pad floods the hull with silver light and restores the airframe.
message.veilreach.vehicle.repair_pad.mis: No damaged vehicle is close enough for the repair pad to catch.
message.veilreach.vehicle.rearm_node.use: The rearm node cycles fresh ordnance into the weapon mounts.
message.veilreach.vehicle.rearm_node.mis: No armed vehicle is close enough for the rearm node.
The recall beacon drags the vehicle back through the veil currents.
No vehicle answers the recall beacon.
message.veilreach.vehicle.deployment_pad: Place a vehicle item on the pad to deploy it cleanly.
subtitle.veilreach.hushlands: The silver hush closes behind you.
title.veilreach.hushlands.outer.subtitle: The hush is thin enough to breathe, for now.
title.veilreach.hushlands.mid.subtitle: The veil strains here and the fog starts to bite back.
title.veilreach.hushlands.inner.subtitle: Every step forward is taken on borrowed breath.
subtitle.veilreach.biome.hush_grove: The world falls silent beneath silver roots.
subtitle.veilreach.biome.gloam_forest: The dark timber creaks as if it remembers you.
subtitle.veilreach.biome.moonlit_thicket: Cold light gathers across every leaf.
subtitle.veilreach.biome.rift_meadows: The air flickers with tears in the veil.
subtitle.veilreach.biome.silent_badlands: Ash and stone swallow every distant sound.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.hushlands_whisp: The hush murmurs through the fog.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_meadows_re: The veil hums with fractured light.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.hush_portal_loo: The Hush Portal sings in a low silver tone.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.hushling_lunge: A hushling darts through the mist.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.molotov_ignite: A rag catches and begins to burn.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.little_bird_rot: Rotor blades chop the air overhead.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.little_bird_roc: Rockets streak away from the pylons.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.little_bird_bom: A cluster bomb slips from the helicopter.
Cluster bombs burst across the ground.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.little_bird_hit: The helicopter frame takes a hit.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.little_bird_exp: The helicopter erupts in a violent blast.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_skimmer_lo: A skimmer hums over the ground.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_skimmer_pu: A rift pulse cracks from the prow.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_skimmer_ex: The skimmer bursts apart in a flare of silver light.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_siege_hum: A heavy siege platform drones overhead.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_siege_cann: A siege cannon booms through the hush.
subtitle.veilreach.sound.rift_siege_expl: The siege platform detonates in a brutal blast.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.gather: Objective: Gather Veil Shards, Hushberries, and Lunar Fiber in the outer hush.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.find_w: Objective: Secure a Hush Ward Charm and press into the rift belt.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.defeat: Objective: Hunt the Warden of Silence for a Warden Sigil.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.find_c: Objective: Recover the Cathedral Seal from Moonfall Cathedral.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.find_s: Objective: Recover the Sanctum Key from the Sunken Sanctum.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.awaken: Objective: Bring the relics to the Sealed Altar and awaken the Sovereign.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.objective.deep_b: Objective: Push beyond the badlands under the Sovereign Ward.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.warning.mid: Warning: the rift fog is corroding your breath. A Hush Ward Charm is needed here.
hud.veilreach.hushlands.warning.inner: Warning: the inner hush is overwhelming. You need a Sovereign Ward.
hud.veilreach.little_bird.fire_hint: R 12x salvo / V lock / B trackers / X clear / G bomb / C descend
hud.veilreach.rift_skimmer.fire_hint: R pulse bolts / W-S speed / A-D strafe / Space climb / C descend
hud.veilreach.rift_siege_platform.fire_h: R heavy cannon / G suppressor / W-S speed / A-D strafe / Space climb / C descend
